newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soymeal drops late on fund long liquidation.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soymeal drops late on fund long liquidation.

text.p: CBOT soymeal dropped sharply lower and July was in fast trading on fund long liquidation, traders said.
"It's just the erosive effect of long liquidation, they're getting out of their longs," a trader said.
SAK Futures sold 700 lots of July late and Prudential Securities also was a key seller, the traders said.
Traders also said soybeans broke below 50-day moving averages which triggered a late round of selling in the soymeal and soybean pits.
At 1300 CDT, soymeal was $3.40 per ton lower to $0.80 higher, with July down $2.90 at $286.00 per ton.
